title: TX queue C conformance: enforce exhaustive vector case coverage
description: Round-3 security review found scenario validation still covers selected cases/fields only. Cases such as expiry_multiple_packets, routing_never_starved_by_bulk, capacity_enforced_strictly, and some initial packet fields can drift without affecting generated output. Make supported case coverage explicit and exhaustive: either consume/generate every vector case or reject unknown/unconsumed cases and validate all behavior-defining fields.
acceptance_criteria: Every case name in the four TX queue vector documents is explicitly consumed/validated or explicitly declared metadata-only; unexpected cases/fields fail generation; representative generated scenarios drive C behavior; sanitizer-backed tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by host sanitizer suite plus review cycle; superseding round-4 findings are tracked separately
